steps.title: Meet Text to Speech
steps.text: These blocks make your project talk out loud. It needs an internet connection to work. Let's take a quick tour, then make a sprite speak.

steps.title: Say something
steps.text: Type what you want your project to say, and it speaks the words out loud. The script waits until the speaking is done before moving on.

steps.title: Set a voice
steps.text: Choose how your project sounds: alto, tenor, squeak, giant or kitten. Every "speak" block after this one uses the voice you picked.

steps.title: Set a language
steps.text: Choose the language it speaks. Pick one that matches the words you typed, or they won't sound right.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “speak” under it, then click your sprite to hear it talk. Then try setting a voice first!

waitFor.label: Drag the “speak” block into the code area
